ctx.x: All right, we played a golf ball down in Gaffin's partner, I'll put it that way. After a section of golf ball, let me see the wet bottle golf ball. So, after a lot of time, every band broke up. Well, there was a Watson band, the Fair Christian, who had been there, they'd been famous for many years back in the olden days. It was a brother, mostly a brother band.
Oh, all brother? No, Harry Watson and that. Oh, man.

There was Harry Watson, the trumpet. Um... Eddie was a guitarist. Gator, which I think his name is Henry Watson, was a banjo. And Charlie Watson, who was a drummer. And they had a bass player by the name of Selva Thomas. And my sister, Anita Jackson, played the piano. Now, she went out, she was playing with them at that time. So, as the years went on, and I began to pick up on my little knowledge on the piano. And little years went on. I don't know how it happened, but I got in with the Watson boys.
